subject: Music Production
title: Latency and Real-Time Processing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Latency and Real-Time Processing.

hook.text: A singer wearing headphones notices a tiny delay between singing and hearing the playback.

buildup.text: This delay is called latency, caused by the time a computer takes to process audio digitally.

discovery.text: Latency above ten milliseconds becomes distracting and makes it difficult to perform in time.

twist.text: Powerful audio interfaces use special chips to reduce latency to nearly imperceptible levels.

climax.text: Managing latency is one of the biggest technical challenges in modern digital music production.

punchline.text: A few milliseconds of delay can ruin a performance.

quiz.question: At what point does latency become distracting for performers?
